description: This file contains functions and scripts for configuring and managing a MBIM (Mobile Broadband Interface Model) connection within a network interface framework. It includes initialization, setup, configuration retrieval, and teardown procedures for the MBIM protocol, using external tools such as 'umbim' and interacting with system files and JSON configurations.

methods.name: proto_mbim_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the MBIM protocol configuration, defining available options and defaults.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_get_field
methods.description: Extracts specific fields from the MBIM configuration output.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Handles the setup process for an MBIM network interface, including device detection, registration, and IP configuration.

methods.name: proto_mbim_teardown
methods.description: Performs cleanup and disconnect procedures for a specified MBIM interface.
